orbital greenhouse keeper, near-future, rendered as cinematic photoreal concept art moodboard, a punchy saturated candy palette, cracked dry clay

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'orbital greenhouse keeper, near-future, rendered as cinematic photoreal'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast. Lighting reference: a single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
